correctness.rationale: For sorted shortest arm a and remaining b_i, exact pair integrations yield the displayed homogeneous cubic in a,B,S₂,S₃. Pairwise averaging decreases the strict convex polynomial contribution f(t)=t²(a+2B−t), so the longer arms balance. The resulting one-variable cubic has only an interior maximum, and endpoint comparison gives the unique m≥4 boundary infimum (2m−3)L/[4(m−1)²] and convergence of all minimizing sequences. Independent comparison with a separately derived all-m cubic and rigid balancing-gap proof confirms the same theorem; finite quadrature is corroboration only.
